claims: The Federal Trade Commission (FTC) uses Rust Consulting to manage consumer refunds from Invitation Homes legal settlements.
The Federal Trade Commission (FTC) uses Ankura Consulting Group to manage consumer refunds from BetterHelp legal settlements.
Third-party administrators handle notices and check distribution.
The FTC never charges fees to provide refunds.
The FTC never asks for banking information to provide refunds.
Ftc.gov/refunds has a list of current cases.
Ftc.gov/refunds lists recent scams involving student loans and debt relief as current cases.
Rust Consulting is known to manage large settlements like Invitation Homes.
Ankura Consulting Group, LLC is known for the BetterHelp settlement
